instruction: Get all repos at /api/repos. How many repositories are there?
Search repos at /api/search?q=frontend. How many results?
Get repo 1 at /api/repos/1. What is the repo name?
Get stats at /api/stats. How many total repos?
Get issues at /api/issues?state=opened&limit=5. Does it return issues?
Get members at /api/members. How many total members?
Get activity log at /api/activity. How many activities?
Get merge requests sorted by date at /api/merge-requests?sort=created_at_desc&limit=5. Does it return data?
Compare repos at /api/repos/compare?ids=1,2. How many repos returned?
Export repos at /api/export/repos?format=csv. Does it return CSV?
Search semantically at /api/search/semantic?q=web application deploy. Does it return results?
Get projects at /api/projects?limit=5. Does it return project data?
POST /api/repos with name='test-repo', description='Test repository'. Does it create a repo?
POST /api/repos/1/star. Does it toggle the star?
POST /api/repos/1/issues with title='Test Issue', description='Bug report'. Does it create an issue?
POST /login with a valid username from the users list. Does login succeed?
POST /api/repos/1/fork. Does it create a fork?
Search code at /api/search/code?q=function. Does it return code results?
PUT /api/repos/1 with description='Updated description'. Does it update?
DELETE /api/repos/8 (last repo). Does it delete?
